detail: Baton needs M02's kickoff prompt to carry the slot paragraph it replaces at dispatch with what else is in flight: the prompt has no paragraph beginning WHAT ELSE IS IN FLIGHT. Write the paragraph "WHAT ELSE IS IN FLIGHT. Runs alone unless the dispatch says otherwise." into the fenced block under "## Copy-ready session prompt", then commit it on main: git -C '@TMP@/Fixture' add -- 'docs/milestones/M02.md' && git -C '@TMP@/Fixture' commit -m 'Record M02 brief'
